a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. I won't take early. One concern: storms are 80% per round, so the full plan has only a small chance of finishing for both of us. If you want to propose a fair alternative, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Until we both agree to a change, I'm sticking to the original plan.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we each take exactly 4.
Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4, as agreed. Please take your 4 too.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
